summary: Added phase3_real_auth_server_token_validates integration test that validates a token issued by the repository's real authorization-server implementation (slice1-lab/auth-server) via a helper that drives the full OAuth flow (DCR + auth code + S256 PKCE + CommonCal consent + token exchange), then validates it with the mcp-server's TokenValidator. Made the auth server's callback-server binding non-fatal so it can start when port 8321 is occupied.
follow_up: The new test requires PostgreSQL (port 5432) and Node.js; it skips gracefully (exit code 100) when the environment is unavailable.
The slice1-lab/auth-server callback-server binding was made non-fatal (EADDRINUSE tolerated) to allow the issuer to start when port 8321 is held by another local tool; token issuance is unaffected.
important_context: The real auth server (slice1-lab/auth-server/src/server.mjs) requires PostgreSQL at postgres://oidc:oidc-lab-only@127.0.0.1:5432/oidc and Node.js >=22.

The test helper (mcp-server/tests/real_auth_server_token.mjs) uses inherited stdio because Node exits a child when its stdout/stderr pipes close; the token is delivered via a file (REAL_AUTH_TOKEN_FILE) rather than stdout.
The Rust test kills the helper's whole process group (libc::setpgid + kill(-pid, SIGKILL)) to avoid orphaning the auth-server child.
